coordinateSystem: Original body-fixed radar-model Cartesian axes; positive Z is the selected spin pole; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: Busch et al. (2008), Icarus 195, 614–621; Arecibo, Goldstone and NASA/JPL: ecliptic J2000 lambda 15 deg, beta -22 deg, period 3.697 h; equatorial conversion uses J2000 obliquity 23.439291111 deg. The published model has uneven latitude coverage, including an unseen region near the north pole. Its small depressions and rounded outline are radar-derived geometry; no measured optical surface texture is supplied.
